_comment: STRICT Claude Desktop config — zero MCP servers, all extension features disabled. Use for regulated environments (finance, healthcare, government) where AI tool access must be minimized.

_enterprise_policies._comment: Deploy these via MDM (macOS managed preferences or Windows registry). They are NOT part of this JSON file — listed here as a reference.

_managed_settings._comment: Deploy these in Claude Code managed settings (same file used by the Desktop Code tab). Desktop-only keys such as sshHostAllowlist are ignored by the standalone CLI.
